Satellites

Location
Kenya, Chad, Western Sahara
Type
Satellite imagery

Mass migration has created new residential areas that public satellite imagery in Europe barely records: over Calais, updates stopped between 2004 and 2015 while the camp grew. African camps, by contrast, are tracked closely. Each image is stitched from hundreds of HD screenshots, to give these places a visual dignity and read their growth through the principles of town planning.
